pattern.description: The particle orb disperses while an oversized, out-of-focus gradient 'V' sweeps in from the upper left and racks toward focus, with a second blurred green glyph sliding in from the right edge; the previous subtitle fades out.
pattern.why_premium: Type used at architectural scale with depth-of-field blur and film grain turns a product name into a cinematic object; crossing from particles to letterform links the voice visual to the 'v4' brand mark.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: orb gsap.to({opacity:0, scale:1.2, duration:0.5, ease:'power2.in'}); subtitle gsap.to({opacity:0, duration:0.25}); V gsap.fromTo({x:-300, y:-200, scale:0.8, filter:'blur(30px)', opacity:0}, {x:0, y:0, scale:1, filter:'blur(6px)', opacity:1, duration:0.7, ease:'power3.out'}) at '-=0.3'; second glyph fromTo({x:200, filter:'blur(30px)'}, {x:0, filter:'blur(14px)', duration:0.5, ease:'power3.out'}) at '-=0.3'.
build_hint.remotion: spring({frame: frame - 6, fps, config:{damping:200, stiffness:90}}) drives V translate (-300,-200 -> 0), scale 0.8 -> 1 and blur 30 -> 6px (no overshoot); second glyph same spring delayed ~10 frames from the right; orb opacity interpolate(frame, [0, 15], [1, 0]) with Easing.in(Easing.quad).

notes: Subtitle (b03) is small Chinese text read from the first filmstrip frame; only the second clause is legible, so the text is partial and should be checked. The green right-edge shape is likely the '4' of 'v4' but is too blurred to confirm. Camera move is none; the 1.2 scale sum is the V growing, not a camera push.
